integrity: The proof is exact operator algebra. No numerical experiment is used as evidence; literature comparisons were made at the level of statements and implications.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the source linearized critical-temperature operator with one scalar parameter multiplying all off-diagonal interaction blocks. Non-bipartite graphs can still have accidental sign symmetry, and no converse for the critical temperature is claimed.
title: Bipartite band networks are exactly sign-gauge symmetric in multiband BCS linearization
